title: The Next Tide
logline: A lighthouse keeper finds a message in a bottle dated forty years in the future, written in her own handwriting.
brief: A quiet 40-second mystery trailer with one keeper, one lighthouse, three voiceover lines, and no generated on-screen text.
style_bible: Restrained photographic coastal mystery at blue hour. Cold blue-gray sea and sky, weathered stone, damp surfaces with believable reflections, warm amber practical light only in the keeper's room. Natural skin detail, moderate contrast, fine film grain, no fantasy glow, no exaggerated teal-orange grade. Slow deliberate camera movement. No generated lettering, titles, logos, or subtitles.
music_prompt: Instrumental score for a restrained forty-second coastal mystery trailer. Sparse low piano notes, a soft sustained bowed texture, a slow pulse that becomes slightly more insistent near the last third, then a quiet resolved tail for a two-second title. No vocals, speech, recognizable melody, named-artist imitation, or loud trailer impacts. Leave space for three short quiet voiceover lines.

shots.slug: EXT. NORTH POINT LIGHTHOUSE - BLUE HOUR
shots.action: Wide view of North Point Lighthouse from the stone path at blue hour. Lighthouse on the left third, gray sea behind it, keeper's cottage visible, one warm window. No people, signs or lettering.
shots.motion: Slow 20 cm push along the path. Sea moves gently. The building stays rigid and the beacon rotates slowly without changing architecture.

shots.action: Medium view from behind Elin at the edge of the headland. She wears a dark navy wool sweater under a faded mustard raincoat. Message Bottle rests on wet stone near her. Lighthouse is recognizable but distant. Hands are natural and do not obscure the bottle.
shots.motion: Elin bends slightly and reaches toward Message Bottle once. A small wave recedes. No repeated reaching, disappearing bottle, or extra fingers.

shots.action: Close view of the wooden table in Keeper's Room. Message Bottle lies on its side beside unfolded cream paper, warm lamp glow from left, blue window reflection in glass. No hands. Marks on paper are not relied on for readable words.
shots.motion: Slow 5 cm push toward the paper. One corner moves slightly in a draft and settles. Bottle stays still. No self-writing text.
shots.dialogue: The date is forty years from now.

shots.action: Close side view of Elin in Keeper's Room, wearing a dark navy wool sweater under a faded mustard raincoat. Her face is lit by the warm lamp with blue twilight on the far side. She looks down at the table. Mouth relaxed and closed.
shots.motion: Elin lifts her eyes once toward the window and holds. Tiny breath movement, no speech, head morphing, or dramatic expression change.

shots.action: Wide view of North Point Lighthouse across the dark water, with the same tower and cottage silhouette as TR-S1. The lantern beam points into the empty blue-gray horizon. No boats or new buildings.
shots.motion: Locked camera. One slow lighthouse-beam sweep across the water, low natural wave movement. No flashing, lightning, or additional lights.

shots.action: Frontal close-up of Elin in Keeper's Room, with the same face and dark navy wool sweater under a faded mustard raincoat. Warm lamp catches one side of her face and the background falls softly out of focus. Her gaze is just below lens, as though reading the paper. The bottle is not visible.
shots.motion: A small eye movement toward the camera, one restrained inhale, then stillness. Mouth does not speak. Hold the final second with stable identity.
